fact: On 16 October 2026 the Federal Government commissioned the first tower of the Nigeria Universal Communication Access Project in Bende, Abia State, the start of a rollout of 3,700 sites to connect nearly 20 million people in unserved and underserved communities.
title: FG Launches First NUCAP Tower in Abia State; to Bring Connectivity Closer to Rural Communities
publisher: Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy
